what: Moving the cursor anywhere tilts the photo toward it in 3D — the cursor’s distance from the photo center divided by the photo’s half width·half height (−1~1, clamped outside) times a max of 20°, tilting on the Y and X axes over .5s power3.out. Far outside the photo, it stays fully tilted.
note: Perspective goes on the parent. It is not applied on touch devices or with reduced motion

from.where: about.html .rc-about__pic (small portrait in the About section) — original init3dPerspectiveHover: data-max-rotate 20, .5s power3.out, pointermove batched by rAF (Osmo 3D Perspective Hover)
